method: Header bytes re-read from original/game/cataclysm.exe (PE sections parsed): shipHeaders 0x8B1938 indexes 51 distinct 0x8C-byte CustShipHeaders (sizeofShipSpecifics + 34 slots); type names from shiptypeinfo 0x889530 (order == CET ShipDefs.h). 324 distinct slot targets, all functions in the r2a export (A1 created them and labelled 227 as <Module><Slot>). Slot semantics from objdump call sites through ship->staticinfo: +04 StaticInit, +0C Init, +10 Close (univFreeShipContents), +14 Fire, +18 AttackPassive (processPassiveAttackToDo), +1C SpecialActivate, +20 SpecialTarget, +24 OrderChanged (FreeCommandToDoContents/FreeLastOrder), +28 HouseKeep, +2C RemoveShipReferences, +30 second RemoveShipReferences hook (always the same fn as +2C; cat_univShipDeferredUpdate, UpdateMidLevelHyperspacingShips path), +34 EffectRemoval (FUN_005475E0 walks all ships for etgEffectDelete/etgDeleteEffectsOwnedBy), +38 BulletRemoval, +3C Died, +40/+44/+48/+4C _PreFix/_Save/_Load/_Fix, +50 move filter (clMove reads statinfo+0x158), +54 Attack, +58 dock filter (clDock), +5C launch filter (FUN_0044A220 via clLaunchMultipleShips; unused by any header), +6C halt filter (clHalt), +88 formation filter (clFormation); +74 has no caller found. Each Cataclysm header was lined up against the HW1 initializer parsed from HomeworldSDL/src/Ships/*.c; where HW1 has a function in that slot the HW1 name is used verbatim (incl. HW1 spellings MinelayerCorvetteHousekeep, MineLayerCorvetteDied, SalCapDied, GravWellClose/GravWellAttack, AdvacedSupportFrigateSpecialTarget). ICF-folded bodies shared by several headers are named after the module whose code range holds the kept copy (address order between that module's other slot functions) and the HW1 body they equal is cited. The 26 unnamed FUN_ slot targets were decompiled and named. Not proposed: shared stubs 0x497DB0 (kasfSpecialOff, missions), 0x49AE30 nullsub, 0x6FE9A0 nullsubReturnFalse (already in ships.verified). 57 data entries (6 tables + 51 headers) re-emitted from ships.verified.json. Subsystem = earliest race (FirstShipTypeOfRace order) among the ship types using the header; tables go with race_sect. No CET anchor lies in 0x5AD000-0x5CA000.
